decisions.reason: Process data archiving and reporting software has its own web page and sits at the core of the firm's announced connected, data-driven direction, so the investment and public commitment strongly favor keeping it.
This second archiving product overlaps with A and is less visible, but it fits the digital strategy, so management would more likely merge or rebrand it than withdraw it outright.
The manhole door with safety railing extends the established hardware line with its own page, and safety equipment for municipal operators sells steadily, so there is little reason to drop it.
The floating sludge extractor builds on the core water-treatment machinery business, and slow uptake can still be attributed to long municipal procurement cycles, which supports persisting with it.
Flow measurement automation and system software was recently launched with its own page and fits the data-driven infrastructure management direction, so management would give it time to prove itself.
